title: Node.js Express API
notes: Key decisions: Alpine base cuts 700MB+. package*.json copied before source for cache efficiency. Non-root node user. dumb-init handles signals correctly.
code:
# ── Stage 1: Dependencies ──────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci --only=production

# ── Stage 2: Build ──────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS build
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# ── Stage 3: Production ─────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner
RUN apk add --no-cache dumb-init
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY --from=build /app/dist ./dist
COPY package.json ./
USER node
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --start-period=10s \
  CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:3000/health || exit 1
ENTRYPOINT ["dumb-init","--"]
CMD ["node","dist/server.js"]

title: FastAPI / Django App
notes: Key decisions: Virtual environment in /venv avoids system package conflicts. PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE and PYTHONUNBUFFERED are essential for containers. Copies only the venv to final stage.
code:
# ── Stage 1: Builder ────────────────────────
FROM python:3.12-slim AS builder
WORKDIR /app
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
RUN python -m venv /venv
ENV PATH="/venv/bin:$PATH"
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir --upgrade pip \
    && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt

# ── Stage 2: Production ─────────────────────
FROM python:3.12-slim AS runner
WORKDIR /app
ENV PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 \
    PATH="/venv/bin:$PATH"
COPY --from=builder /venv /venv
COPY . .
RUN useradd --no-create-home --shell /bin/false appuser
USER appuser
EXPOSE 8000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s \
  CMD python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://localhost:8000/health')"
CMD ["uvicorn","app.main:app","--host","0.0.0.0","--port","8000"]

title: Go REST API
notes: Key decisions: Go compiles to a single static binary. FROM scratch produces a ~12MB image with zero attack surface — no shell, no OS utilities. CGO_ENABLED=0 ensures no libc dependency.
code:
# ── Stage 1: Build ──────────────────────────
FROM golang:1.22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
ENV CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
COPY . .
RUN go build \
    -ldflags="-w -s" \
    -o /app/server \
    ./cmd/server

# ── Stage 2: Production (scratch) ───────────
FROM scratch AS runner
COPY --from=builder /etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt /etc/ssl/certs/
COPY --from=builder /app/server /server
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s \
  CMD ["/server","-health"]
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]

title: Next.js App (standalone)
notes: Key decisions: Next.js standalone output copies only needed files. Set output: "standalone" in next.config.js first. Sharp for image optimization must be copied from builder.
code:
# ── Stage 1: Dependencies ──────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS deps
RUN apk add --no-cache libc6-compat
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci

# ── Stage 2: Build ──────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=deps /app/node_modules ./node_modules
COPY . .
ENV NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
RUN npm run build

# ── Stage 3: Production ─────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app
ENV NODE_ENV=production NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
RUN addgroup --system nodejs && adduser --system nextjs
COPY --from=builder /app/public ./public
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs \
  /app/.next/standalone ./
COPY --from=builder --chown=nextjs:nodejs \
  /app/.next/static ./.next/static
USER nextjs
EXPOSE 3000
ENV PORT=3000 HOSTNAME="0.0.0.0"
CMD ["node","server.js"]

title: Spring Boot (JRE 21)
notes: Key decisions: Spring Boot layered jars split deps/app for better caching. JRE (not JDK) in production stage cuts 200MB+. Application layer changes most often — placed last.
code:
# ── Stage 1: Extract layers ─────────────────
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jdk-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY target/*.jar app.jar
RUN java -Djarmode=layertools -jar app.jar extract

# ── Stage 2: Production ─────────────────────
FROM eclipse-temurin:21-jre-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app
RUN addgroup -S spring && adduser -S spring -G spring
# Copy layers in order of change frequency (least → most)
COPY --from=builder /app/dependencies/ ./
COPY --from=builder /app/spring-boot-loader/ ./
COPY --from=builder /app/snapshot-dependencies/ ./
COPY --from=builder /app/application/ ./
USER spring
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s \
  CMD wget -qO- http://localhost:8080/actuator/health || exit 1
ENTRYPOINT ["java","org.springframework.boot.loader.JarLauncher"]

title: Rust Axum API
notes: Key decisions: Rust target x86_64-unknown-linux-musl produces a fully static binary. cargo-chef caches dependencies layer separately — huge build time savings on code changes.
code:
# ── Stage 1: Planner ────────────────────────
FROM rust:1.78-alpine AS planner
RUN apk add --no-cache musl-dev
WORKDIR /app
RUN cargo install cargo-chef
COPY . .
RUN cargo chef prepare --recipe-path recipe.json

# ── Stage 2: Cache deps ─────────────────────
FROM rust:1.78-alpine AS cacher
RUN apk add --no-cache musl-dev
RUN cargo install cargo-chef
WORKDIR /app
COPY --from=planner /app/recipe.json recipe.json
RUN cargo chef cook --release --recipe-path recipe.json

# ── Stage 3: Build ──────────────────────────
FROM rust:1.78-alpine AS builder
RUN apk add --no-cache musl-dev
WORKDIR /app
COPY . .
COPY --from=cacher /app/target target
COPY --from=cacher /usr/local/cargo /usr/local/cargo
RUN cargo build --release

# ── Stage 4: Production (distroless) ────────
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12 AS runner
COPY --from=builder /app/target/release/server /server
EXPOSE 8080
CMD ["/server"]

title: Laravel (PHP-FPM + Nginx)
notes: Key decisions: PHP-FPM with a separate Nginx container is the production pattern. Composer installs without dev dependencies. OPcache enabled for performance.
code:
# ── Stage 1: Composer deps ──────────────────
FROM composer:2 AS vendor
WORKDIR /app
COPY composer.json composer.lock ./
RUN composer install \
    --no-dev \
    --no-interaction \
    --prefer-dist \
    --optimize-autoloader \
    --no-scripts

# ── Stage 2: PHP-FPM app ────────────────────
FROM php:8.3-fpm-alpine AS runner
RUN apk add --no-cache \
    libpng-dev libzip-dev \
    && docker-php-ext-install \
       pdo_mysql zip gd opcache
COPY docker/php/opcache.ini /usr/local/etc/php/conf.d/
COPY docker/php/www.conf /usr/local/etc/php-fpm.d/www.conf
WORKDIR /var/www/html
COPY --from=vendor /app/vendor ./vendor
COPY . .
RUN chown -R www-data:www-data storage bootstrap/cache
USER www-data
EXPOSE 9000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s \
  CMD php-fpm -t || exit 1

title: React (Vite + Nginx)
notes: Key decisions: Node only needed at build time — final image is just Nginx serving static files. Custom nginx.conf enables gzip, SPA routing (try_files), and security headers.
code:
# ── Stage 1: Build ──────────────────────────
FROM node:20-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
COPY package*.json ./
RUN npm ci
COPY . .
RUN npm run build

# ── Stage 2: Serve with Nginx ───────────────
FROM nginx:1.25-alpine AS runner
COPY --from=builder /app/dist /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY docker/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/conf.d/default.conf
# nginx.conf should include:
#   try_files $uri $uri/ /index.html; (SPA routing)
#   gzip on;
#   security headers (X-Frame-Options, etc.)
EXPOSE 80
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s \
  CMD wget -qO- http://localhost/health || exit 1
CMD ["nginx","-g","daemon off;"]
